title: Instanced Forest with LOD and Physics Debug Overlay
prompt:
Create a single HTML file using Three.js (via CDN) that renders an instanced mesh forest with three LOD levels and a toggleable physics debug wireframe overlay.

SCENE SETUP:
- Use a PerspectiveCamera at position (0, 80, 200) looking at origin.
- Add a large ground plane (1000x1000) with a green-brown textured material (use procedural noise or a simple color).
- Add a HemisphereLight (sky: 0x87CEEB, ground: 0x3a5f0b, intensity 0.6) and a DirectionalLight (0xffffff, intensity 0.8) at position (100, 150, 50) casting shadows.
- Enable shadow mapping on the renderer (PCFSoftShadowMap).

FOREST GENERATION:
- Generate exactly 3000 trees distributed randomly across the ground plane within a radius of 400 units from center.
- Each tree is represented by a simple cone (trunk: CylinderGeometry, canopy: ConeGeometry) merged or grouped.
- Use THREE.InstancedMesh for each LOD level. Create 3 LOD tiers:
  * LOD0 (high detail): cone with 16 radial segments, cylinder with 12 segments. Used when distance < 80.
  * LOD1 (medium detail): cone with 8 radial segments, cylinder with 6 segments. Used when distance 80-200.
  * LOD2 (low detail): cone with 4 radial segments, cylinder with 4 segments. Used when distance >= 200.
- Store tree positions in an array. On each frame, compute distance from camera to each tree and assign it to the correct LOD InstancedMesh by updating instance matrices. Track counts per LOD level.
- Vary tree scale randomly between 0.7 and 1.4 for each tree (set once at generation).
- Vary canopy color slightly per instance using instanceColor (shades of green, hue range 0.25-0.38).

PHYSICS DEBUG OVERLAY:
- Simulate a simple bounding-box physics representation for each tree: an axis-aligned box that encloses the tree geometry.
- The debug overlay renders these as wireframe boxes (EdgesGeometry + LineSegments or wireframe BoxGeometry) colored yellow (0xFFFF00).
- The debug overlay is OFF by default. Toggle it with the 'D' key.
- When debug overlay is ON, only show debug boxes for trees within 150 units of the camera (for performance).
- Track the number of visible debug boxes.

CAMERA CONTROLS:
- Implement orbit-style controls: left-click drag rotates, scroll zooms (clamp distance 30-500).
- Arrow keys move the camera target point: Left/Right strafe by 5 units, Up/Down move forward/backward by 5 units relative to camera facing direction.
- Each time the camera moves, the LOD distribution must update.

FRUSTUM CULLING STATS:
- On each frame, count how many trees are inside the camera frustum (use a Frustum object extracted from the camera projection*view matrix). Store this as visibleTreeCount.

HUD / UI:
- Show a fixed overlay div (top-left, dark semi-transparent background, white text, monospace font) displaying:
  * FPS (computed via a simple frame-time average over last 60 frames)
  * Total trees: 3000
  * LOD0 count / LOD1 count / LOD2 count
  * Visible (frustum): <visibleTreeCount>
  * Debug overlay: ON/OFF
  * Debug boxes shown: <count>
- Add a button labeled 'Reset Camera' that resets camera to initial position and target.
- Add a button labeled 'Toggle Debug' that also toggles the debug overlay (same as D key).
- Add a dropdown select with options: 'All Trees', 'LOD0 Only', 'LOD1 Only', 'LOD2 Only'. When a filter is selected, only the chosen LOD level(s) are rendered (set others' visible = false). 'All Trees' shows all.

STATE MANAGEMENT:
Expose window.__3D_STATE__ with these fields, updated every frame:
- totalTrees: 3000 (constant)
- lodCounts: { lod0: <number>, lod1: <number>, lod2: <number> } — instance counts per LOD
- lodCountSum: lod0 + lod1 + lod2 (should always equal totalTrees)
- visibleTreeCount: number of trees in frustum
- debugOverlayActive: boolean
- debugBoxCount: number of debug wireframe boxes currently shown
- cameraPosition: { x, y, z } — current camera world position
- cameraDistance: number — distance from camera to its target
- fps: number — current FPS
- lodFilter: 'all' | 'lod0' | 'lod1' | 'lod2'
- frameCount: number — total frames rendered
- treePositions: array of {x, y, z} for first 10 trees (for verification)
- groundPlaneSize: 1000
- shadowsEnabled: boolean
- lodThresholds: { lod0Max: 80, lod1Max: 200 }
physics_constraints: LOD counts must always sum to exactly 3000 (totalTrees). Debug boxes must only appear for trees within 150 units of camera when overlay is active. Camera distance must stay clamped between 30 and 500. All tree positions must be within radius 400 of origin on the XZ plane. Tree scales must be in range [0.7, 1.4]. visibleTreeCount must be <= totalTrees. debugBoxCount must be 0 when overlay is inactive.
